The company exhibits a strong financial profile with solid profitability (EBIT margin of ~23.3% and Return on Assets of ~2.7%), a healthy leverage position (Total Liabilities to Total Assets of ~64.8%), and good short-term liquidity (Current Ratio of 1.35x). The substantial equity cushion of $1.44B relative to total assets supports an investment-grade rating, though the absolute size of revenue ($868M) places it in the upper-tier of mid-sized issuers.

DECISION: BBB+
